title: Source dimension formula for coherent cohomology on a finite clopen partition
statement: Let k be a field, X a k-scheme, I a finite index type, and U_i pairwise disjoint opens with union X. Let M be an O_X-module and q in N. Suppose its source module cohomology H^q(X,M) is finite dimensional over k. Then finrank_k H^q(X,M) is the sum over i of finrank_k H^q(U_i,M|_{U_i}), where each U_i has the structure map induced from X. Pullback is the module restriction used on the right. Empty X and an empty index type are allowed. This is exactly the existing finrankH_eq_sum_of_pairwise_disjoint source API.

source.place: Tag 01E1, cohomology on opens and disjoint-cover assembly; existing proof finrankH_eq_sum_of_pairwise_disjoint in WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/Cohomology/EulerChar.lean

proof.text: The complement of each U_i is the union of the other opens, so every U_i is closed. The adjunction units identify M with the finite biproduct of the pushforwards of its restrictions: this is the sheaf gluing axiom on the disjoint cover in each open of X. Restriction to a clopen subset and extension by zero are inverse componentwise equivalences; cohomology therefore identifies the cohomology of such a pushforward with that on U_i.

The finite biproduct of module cohomologies is the cohomology of M, compatibly with its k-action. The source module-cohomology comparison identifies the ringed-space and source APIs. Projecting the finite-dimensional total cohomology onto each factor makes every factor finite dimensional. A concatenation of bases gives the dimension sum. The source theorem proves this using isIso_biproduct_lift_restrictAdjunction_unit, H.isBilimitLinearEquiv, finrankH_of_isBilimit and finrankH_pushforward_ι.
